paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者喜欢草图里外层连续的深色边缘，却想保留一处短层对照；把颜色换掉后，是否仍喜欢长线尚不清楚。连续、颜色与局部分隔可以分别保留，不由均值推断身高、显瘦效果或天生线条。例子只需想象，不测量身体或规定衣长。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader likes a continuous dark outer edge in a sketch while keeping one short contrasting layer. Its appeal after a colour change remains unknown. Continuity, colour and a local break stay separate without a mean establishing height, a slimming effect or an innate line. Imagining is enough, without body measurements or prescribed garment length.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我喜欢这处边缘连贯，想比较加一处分隔后的画面。”可以与紧凑对照的草图并看，不评价谁穿更高。听者指出具体线条，由本人决定是否喜欢；短层与长轮廓可同时存在，不需要分配Dramatic或其他身体身份。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a continuous edge and compares one added break beside a Compact Contrast sketch. Judge no wearer’s apparent height. A listener points to the line while the reader decides its appeal. A short layer and long outline can coexist without assigning Dramatic or another body identity.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，观察对服装安排的认同，不是David Kibbe的Image Identity、身体测量、合身评估或外貌评分。15条仍为五组各三条直接认同评分；三条数值全部有效才将原始和除以3显示一位小数，任一未评分只让所属项资料不足，不补0或3。3为数值中立，不代表不确定。五项分别保留，不合总分、不排最高家族、不生成锐利柔和或阴阳轴。原创题本尚无独立心理测量验证、常模或中英文测量等值，示例不复制书中练习或插图，也不借用其背书。偏好、想象外观与实际舒适需分开，不要求购买、试穿、上传照片或改变身体。所有组合下五篇全文均可读；审美与造型氛围等独立题本不转移回答或合并数字，本题本保持页面内存作答，不增加个人结果分享。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading about agreement with garment arrangements, not David Kibbe’s Image Identity, body measurement, fit assessment or appearance scoring. Fifteen prompts retain five groups of three direct agreement ratings. All three numeric ratings are required for a raw sum divided by three, displayed to one decimal. Any unscored response leaves only its own part insufficient, without zero or three substituted. Three is numeric Neutral, not uncertainty. Five parts stay separate without a total, highest family, sharp-to-soft or yin-yang axis. The original form lacks independent psychometric validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence. Examples reproduce no book exercises or illustrations and borrow no endorsement. Preference, imagined appearance and actual comfort stay separate, with no required purchase, fitting, photo upload or changed body. All five full guides remain readable for every pattern. Separate Aesthetic and Style Impression forms transfer no answers or combined numbers. This form retains page-memory answers without added personal-result sharing.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者喜欢外层敞开的视觉空间，却不喜欢所有边缘都松散；更换布料后，实际活动与舒适仍需另看。余量、边界和触感需要可以分别描述，不用偏好证明身体宽度或随和性格。例子不要求宽松衣柜、不忽略真实舒适，也不规定穿着方式。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader likes visual space in an open layer but not loosely defined edges everywhere. Actual movement and comfort need separate consideration after a fabric change. Ease, boundaries and tactile needs remain separate without a preference proving body width or an easygoing character. The scene requires no loose wardrobe, ignored comfort or prescribed wear.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我喜欢这里的余地，也想保留一个清楚收尾。”可以与柔和垂落比较边缘走向，只谈想象服装。朋友不由画面保证合身，不把不同意解释为身体不接纳；可以只读、不试穿、不提供身体照片或尺码。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names visible room alongside a defined finish and compares edge movement with Soft Drape in imagined clothes. A friend guarantees no fit from an image and interprets no disagreement as rejection of one’s body. Reading alone needs no fitting, body photograph or size information.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader likes two similarly scaled details with clearly different colours, then enjoys removing one repetition. Balanced scale and colour contrast are different questions, not an average determining taste, professionalism or bodily symmetry. The scene requires no exact set and treats no even arrangement as a required standard.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想比较哪些细节分担注意，而不比较谁更端庄。”可以把一处细节放大，与紧凑对照并看。听者说自己注意到哪里，不替对方评判成熟、地位或比例；可以同时喜欢不同版本，资料不足也不借其他项的数值补全。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card compares how details share attention without judging anyone’s composure. Enlarge one detail beside Compact Contrast. A listener names what draws their eye without judging maturity, status or proportions for the reader. Different versions may both appeal, and an insufficient part borrows no number from another.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader likes a short layer breaking a long outline without added colour clashes. Another sketch keeps only one small crisp detail. Length, scale and colour remain separate without a shared mean establishing age, energy or creativity. The scene prescribes no short clothes, public-figure imitation or body family.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我喜欢这处分隔，想比较拿掉后线条怎样连起来。”可以与连贯长线并看，不问哪种人更适合对照。听者不要求显年轻或吸引注意；比较可以只在纸上完成，喜欢局部变化也不必认可整套描述，更不用接受Gamine身份。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names one break and compares continuity after removing it beside Long Lines. Discuss the visual difference without deciding who should wear contrasting elements. A listener requires no youthful look or attention seeking. A paper comparison can retain one local change without endorsing every description or accepting a Gamine identity.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader likes one curved finish but not gathers, retaining the curve inside a defined long outline. Bending, drape and other structure can be described separately without a mean establishing femininity, bodily softness or romantic preference. The scene requires no soft fabric or changed body and guarantees no actual wearing effect.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想比较这一条弧边和固定直边，不评价穿着者温柔与否。”可以保持颜色相同，与平稳均衡或连贯长线并看。听者不由偏好判断性别或吸引力；只欣赏图形、不实际采用也可以，不需要Romantic或其他Image Identity标签。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card compares one curved edge with a fixed straight edge without judging a wearer’s gentleness. Keep colour constant beside Even Balance or Long Lines. A listener infers no gender or attractiveness from preference. Enjoying the drawing without using it needs no Romantic or other Image Identity label.
